notes: Development means how intensively the land is already used for human purposes; at 100 the location is fully optimised for its current system.

crop_share: HYDE/LUH-derived starting cultivation as a share of the physical area, saturating at crop_share_reference (30% cultivated ~ 63 points of this component). feasible_utilisation: the same cultivation against the maximum feasible cultivation. improvement_share: ledger improvements over starting capacity. management_intensity: management capacity per cultivated hectare against the global p90. pasture: pastoral share (weight 0 by default).

Weights were chosen against the vanilla EU5 regional ordering (Spearman ~0.70 per location, ~0.90 by macro-region mean); this is a sanity reference, not a fitting target, and the map is never adjusted to close capacity gaps.

Ordering and spot-check bands are sanity constraints. Failing checks block the building assignment unless allow_failed_development_checks is set in configs/building_assignment.json, which must be reported.
